claims.claim: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and GPT-6 Astra at 57, up from Argon's 50.
claims.episode_span: Carbon scored 59 on version 5.0 of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and GPT-6 Astra at 57, up from Argon’s 50.
claims.source_title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Review: Reclaims the Top Spot, Hits 88.2% on Vulnerability Detection
claims.supporting_quote: It edged out Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 (58) and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra (57) to retake the top spot.

claims.claim: Carbon scored 88.2 percent on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8 percent on ExploitGym and 71.0 percent on CWE-bench.
claims.episode_span: Carbon scored 88.2 percent on SEC-bench Pro, 54.8 percent on ExploitGym and 71.0 percent on CWE-bench
claims.source_title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with cyber focus
claims.supporting_quote: According to Google, the model scored 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for identifying vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

claims.claim: Introductory Carbon pricing is 2 dollars per million input tokens and 10 dollars per million output tokens, with cached input 95 percent cheaper, and Basic Tutorials said rates later rise to 4 and 20 dollars.
claims.episode_span: Introductory pricing matches Argon at 2 dollars per million input tokens and 10 dollars per million output tokens, cached input 95 percent below the standard input rate
claims.source_title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with cyber focus
claims.supporting_quote: Pricing matches the introductory level for Argon: USD $2 per million input tokens and USD $10 per million output tokens.

claims.claim: The 14-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro starts at 2,899 dollars, the 16-inch at 3,399 dollars, a maxed configuration costs 14,549 dollars, pre-orders open October 30 and launch is November 6.
claims.episode_span: NewsCord put the 14-inch at 2,899 dollars, the 16-inch at 3,399 dollars and a fully loaded configuration at 14,549 dollars
claims.source_title: Apple Unveils Touchscreen MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display Starting At US$2,899
claims.supporting_quote: Apple’s 14-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro starts at US$2,899, while the 16-inch model starts at US$3,399, and a fully maxed-out configuration with 16 terabytes of storage and 128 gigabytes of memory costs US$14,549.

claims.claim: Amazon launched five Alexa devices including Echo Show 16 from 499.99 dollars and confirmed a small number of role cuts, while Reuters reported up to 250 devices-and-services cuts.
claims.episode_span: Amazon on Wednesday launched five devices for its updated Alexa service
claims.source_title: Amazon Launches Alexa Gadgets, Cuts Jobs In Devices Unit
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon on Wednesday launched five new devices designed to promote its updated Alexa AI service , even as it reportedly cut jobs in its devices and services division.

claims.claim: Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to over 30 billion dollars with operating income of 11.12 billion dollars, while Azure revenue was 33 billion dollars, up 48 percent.
claims.episode_span: Google Cloud revenue more than doubled in the September quarter, to over 30 billion dollars, and that unit’s operating income tripled to 11.12 billion dollars.
claims.source_title: Google Cloud Closes In on Azure, but Microsoft Wins the Day With Investors
claims.supporting_quote: Revenue from that business more than doubled in the quarter to over $30 billion, while the unit’s operating income tripled to $11.12 billion.

claims.claim: Alphabet revenue rose 25 percent to 127.58 billion dollars, free cash flow was negative by over 9 billion dollars, and search revenue grew 12 percent to 63.35 billion dollars.
claims.episode_span: Alphabet reported a 25 percent rise in company revenue to 127.58 billion dollars
claims.source_title: Google Cloud Closes In on Azure, but Microsoft Wins the Day With Investors
claims.supporting_quote: Alphabet, the search giant’s parent company, reported a 25% jump in revenue to $127.58 billion, which fell slightly short of Wall Street forecasts.

claims.claim: Microsoft September-quarter revenue rose 19 percent to 92.3 billion dollars and Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud rose 17 percent to 27.7 billion dollars.
claims.episode_span: Microsoft’s September-quarter revenue rose 19 percent to 92.3 billion dollars
claims.source_title: Google Cloud Closes In on Azure, but Microsoft Wins the Day With Investors
claims.supporting_quote: Overall revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion in the September quarter, 1 percentage point faster than the growth it reported in the prior quarter.

claims.claim: On an agentic coding index Carbon with Antigravity scored 59 versus Claude Code with Opus 5.5 at 62, and on FrontierSWE 2 GPT-6 Astra led 65.5 percent to Carbon's 61.2 percent.
claims.episode_span: paired with Google’s Antigravity tool, Carbon scored 59 on an agentic-coding index, short of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 at 62
claims.source_title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Review: Reclaims the Top Spot, Hits 88.2% on Vulnerability Detection
claims.supporting_quote: On the AI agentic coding index, Carbon paired with Google's own Antigravity tool scored 59, higher than the 53 posted by the equivalent Argon combination, but still short of Claude Code paired with Opus 5.5 at 62.

claims.claim: Judge Edward Davila set a schedule including a trial date in Apple's trade-secrets case against two former employees, OpenAI and io Products.
claims.episode_span: Judge Edward Davila set the schedule, including a trial date, in Apple’s trade-secrets case
claims.source_title: Apple and OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit now has an official trial date
claims.supporting_quote: Judge Edward Davila today formally established the schedule for Apple’s trade secrets misappropriation lawsuit against two former employees, OpenAI, and io Products, including a trial date.
